en.summary: Fixes cache request and MSHR scheduling by adding next-entry lookahead so stage-0 arbitration uses the entry that will actually be visible after a pop.
why_it_counts: The substantive logic changes are in cache-bank scheduling structures, not in tests or build-only code.
The patch adds a dedicated input queue with next-entry visibility and extends MSHR scheduling with next-entry outputs.
The bank now latches next core-request or MSHR metadata ahead of arbitration, which is a clear control-path bug fix.
disqualifiers: The same commit also tweaks simulator latency constants and an unrelated LSU pipe-register parameter.
evidence: New VX_input_queue.v exposes data_out_next and empty_next so the bank can see the next queue entry before the pop commits.
VX_bank.v replaces FIFO queues for core requests and DRAM responses with VX_input_queue and latches creq_* from mshr_valid_next or queue next-entry signals.
VX_miss_resrv.v adds schedule_valid_next, schedule_addr_next, and schedule_data_next, and computes next scheduled metadata combinationally before the clock edge.
Hazard and incoming-fill comparisons in VX_bank.v switch from old current-head signals to the newly latched addr_st0 and next-entry state.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix corrects a one-cycle lookahead problem in cache scheduling. The buggy form only exposes the current head of the request and miss queues, so when a pop happens and the next entry should become active immediately, arbitration and hazard logic still see stale address, tag, and data metadata for one cycle. In a pipelined cache, that is enough to mis-handle fill matching, replay ordering, or conflict detection.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: queue and MSHR next-entry lookahead for cache arbitration
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A queue or MSHR entry is popped and the following entry must participate in stage-0 arbitration or hazard checks in the same cycle or immediately afterward.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove next-entry visibility so stage-0 logic uses only the current head and updates metadata one cycle late.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop queue and MSHR next-entry lookahead
portability_notes: Map this to any banked cache or replay queue where a pop changes which request should be considered for the next arbitration cycle.
The important bug is stale metadata after a pop, not the specific queue implementation.
Any design that computes hazards, fill matches, or miss replays from a queue head can reproduce the same class of fault.
concrete_injection_steps: Replace any next-entry or post-pop queue outputs with current-head-only outputs.
Update the selected request or MSHR metadata only after the pop has fully committed, not combinationally before arbitration.
Keep hazard, incoming-fill, and replay comparisons wired to that stale metadata for one extra cycle.
Do not alter queue depth or the replay algorithm itself; the fault should remain a timing and selection error around head transitions.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Stage-0 cache arbitration and MSHR scheduling lookahead
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit introduces VX_input_queue, extends VX_miss_resrv with next-entry schedule outputs, and changes VX_bank to latch next request or MSHR metadata before arbitration and hazard checks.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_bank and VX_miss_resrv, remove the *_next schedule and queue signals, restore current-head-only queue reads, and select stage-0 request metadata from the old current-entry outputs instead of the next-entry values.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: After a pop, the cache can use stale address or tag metadata for miss replay, fill matching, or conflict detection, leading to duplicate fills, wrong replay order, incorrect core responses, or stalls under contention.
evidence_for_injection: The new VX_input_queue module exists specifically to expose both current and next elements, which would not be necessary without a real head-transition bug.
VX_bank.v now latches selected metadata from mshr_valid_next and queue next-entry outputs before stage-0 arbitration.
VX_miss_resrv.v now computes schedule_valid_next and related data combinationally, showing that the missing lookahead was part of the bug.
notes: Focus injection on cache queues and MSHR scheduling; the simulator and LSU edits are not needed.
This is a good cross-DUT fault model for stale queue-head metadata after dequeue.

zh.summary: 该修复为 cache 请求与 MSHR 调度增加了下一项前瞻，使 stage-0 仲裁使用的是真正会在 pop 之后生效的条目。
why_it_counts: 实质性的逻辑改动位于 cache bank 调度结构中，而不是测试或构建代码。
补丁增加了能够看到下一项的输入队列，并把 MSHR 调度扩展为输出下一项元数据。
bank 现在会在仲裁前锁存下一条 core request 或 MSHR 元数据，这是明确的控制路径修复。
disqualifiers: 同一提交还修改了 simulator 的延迟常量，并顺带调整了一个无关的 LSU pipe-register 参数。
evidence: 新文件 VX_input_queue.v 暴露了 data_out_next 和 empty_next，使 bank 能在 pop 真正提交前看到队列下一项。
VX_bank.v 把 core request 和 DRAM response 队列从 FIFO 换成 VX_input_queue，并根据 mshr_valid_next 或队列下一项信号锁存 creq_*。
VX_miss_resrv.v 增加了 schedule_valid_next、schedule_addr_next 和 schedule_data_next，并在时钟边沿之前组合计算下一条调度元数据。
VX_bank.v 中的 hazard 和 incoming-fill 比较从旧的当前队头信号，切换成新锁存的 addr_st0 与下一项状态。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对 cache 调度中的一个一周期前瞻问题。缺陷版本只能看到请求队列和 miss 队列的当前队头，因此当一个 pop 发生、下一条目应当立刻成为新的活跃条目时，仲裁和 hazard 逻辑在一个周期内仍会看到陈旧的地址、tag 和数据元数据。对于流水化 cache 来说，这已经足以破坏 fill 匹配、replay 顺序或冲突检测。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache 仲裁中的队列与 MSHR 下一项前瞻
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个队列或 MSHR 条目被 pop，紧随其后的下一条目需要在同周期或下一周期立刻参与 stage-0 仲裁或 hazard 检查。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 去掉下一项可见性，使 stage-0 逻辑只能看到当前队头，并把元数据更新推迟一个周期。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除队列和 MSHR 的 next-entry 前瞻
portability_notes: 可映射到任何在一次 pop 后、下一条请求应立刻参与仲裁的 banked cache 或 replay queue。
关键缺陷是 pop 之后的元数据陈旧，而不是具体队列实现本身。
只要设计中 hazard、fill 匹配或 miss replay 依赖于队头请求，就能复现同类故障。
concrete_injection_steps: 把所有 next-entry 或 post-pop 队列输出替换回仅有 current-head 的输出。
只在 pop 完整提交之后才更新被选中的 request 或 MSHR 元数据，而不是在仲裁前组合地更新。
让 hazard、incoming-fill 和 replay 比较继续多使用一个周期的陈旧元数据。
不要改变队列深度或 replay 算法本身，使故障保持为队头切换时机错误，而不是更大的结构改动。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: cache stage-0 仲裁与 MSHR 调度前瞻
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交引入 VX_input_queue，为 VX_miss_resrv 增加下一项调度输出，并修改 VX_bank，使其在仲裁和 hazard 检查前锁存下一条 request 或 MSHR 元数据。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_bank 和 VX_miss_resrv 中，移除 *_next 调度与队列信号，恢复为只读取当前队头，并让 stage-0 请求元数据重新来自旧的当前项输出而不是下一项输出。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在一次 pop 之后，cache 可能仍用陈旧的地址或 tag 元数据去做 miss replay、fill 匹配或冲突检测，导致重复 fill、replay 顺序错误、core response 错误或在竞争下停顿。
evidence_for_injection: 新增 VX_input_queue 的目的就是同时暴露当前项和下一项，这说明原先确实存在队头切换相关的真实缺陷。
VX_bank.v 现在会在 stage-0 仲裁之前，根据 mshr_valid_next 和队列下一项输出锁存被选中的元数据。
VX_miss_resrv.v 增加了组合生成的 schedule_valid_next 及相关数据，表明缺陷确实与缺少前瞻有关。
notes: 注入时聚焦 cache 队列和 MSHR 调度即可，不需要带上 simulator 或 LSU 的改动。
这是一个很适合跨 DUT 复用的故障模型：dequeue 后仍然使用陈旧的队头元数据。
